Data Platform Services is building a governed, metadata-driven data integration and staging platform centered on SAP BusinessObjects Data Services (BODS) and enterprise databases/data lakes — spanning source ingestion (SAP ERP/S/4HANA, non-SAP systems), a source-faithful central staging repository, long-term archival, and controlled distribution to multiple downstream systems.

We're looking for a DataOps Engineer who treats ETL pipeline design, data flows, and access-control logic as configuration, not one-off code — someone who builds and maintains systems where metadata tables and control frameworks drive what gets executed (jobs, interfaces, delta loads, transformations, and security masking), rather than hand-crafting individual one-off BODS jobs for every new dataset or consumer.

You'll work across ingestion (landing central staging archive), retention/partitioning strategy, and the routing/distribution rules engine that determines how data is extracted, transformed, filtered, or masked across multiple major downstream systems.

What You'll Do

* Build and operate robust batch and incremental change data capture (CDC) ingestion pipelines using SAP Data Services (BODS) from SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, SLT, ODP/Extractors) and non-SAP sources into central staging repositories/databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, SAP HANA, or Cloud Storage).
* Design and maintain metadata-driven ETL generation & execution frameworks — where dataset onboarding (new source table, delta logic, schema mapping, validation rules) is driven by configuration tables and reusable BODS templates/scripts rather than creating bespoke data flows from scratch.
* Implement and maintain partition-based retention, database archiving, and extraction routines for historical data and rolling window retention policies (e.g., current + N prior years).
* Build and maintain a dataset routing-rules engine: a governed metadata table (splittable, target\_systems[], row\_filter\_expr, column\_mask\_expr) that programmatically directs and transforms BODS distribution jobs and target views per downstream system.
* Own BODS repository architecture & governance: manage local/central repositories, Data Services Management Console (DSMC), user access security, environment promotion (Dev/Test/Prod), and execution auditing/lineage.

* Monitor pipeline health, job execution logs, CDC checkpoint integrity, schema drift, and data SLAs; establish automated alerting and self-healing for job failures and data-freshness breaches.
* Collaborate with upstream SAP functional/basis teams to define data contracts (e.g., Delta queue/ODP parameters, timestamps, extraction load impact) and downstream teams to translate their access/filter requirements into routing rules.

* Monitoring & Observability: Hands-on experience setting up alerting, performance bottleneck troubleshooting (memory/buffer tuning in BODS), and data validation frameworks.

Governance & Collaboration

* Experience serving multiple downstream consumers with varying analytical and operational requirements by delivering filtered and governed interfaces.
* Clear written communication habits; ability to articulate complex ETL architectures and governance rules to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Hands-on experience integrating SAP BODS with cloud data platforms (Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Snowflake, Databricks, or AWS S3).
* Exposure to SAP Landscape Transformation (SLT) or SAP Data Intelligence / Datasphere.
* Experience in large-scale multi-tenant enterprise environments supporting cross-functional business domains (Supply Chain, Finance, Commercial).

Config-Driven Onboarding: Standard source table onboarding (source

* Automated Retention & Purging: Automated partition/date-based archiving and retention mechanisms are operational across staging repositories.

We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Delivery \& stakeholder ownership** — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* **Hands\-on technical leadership \& design** — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* **Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence** — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* **AI\-assisted engineering** — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* **SE \+ SQE leadership** — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* **People management \& culture** — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.

* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.

**Desirable Skills \& Experience*** Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.

We are looking for an experienced Data Platform Solution Architect to join an existing enterprise data platform team. The role requires the ability to rapidly assimilate a complex, partially implemented platform — understanding what has been built, what remains, and what needs to evolve — and to translate that into a clear, actionable architecture that guides the team through current delivery and the next stage of platform transformation. This person will work closely with senior engineers and stakeholders, providing the architectural vision and technical direction needed to complete ongoing work and design the path forward.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
* Rapidly assess and develop a deep understanding of the current platform state across all layers and components, working alongside the existing engineering team
* Define and own the target\-state architecture, bridging the gap between what is currently implemented and what needs to be completed or evolved
* Drive non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance, security, and resilience — into platform design
* Design the architectural roadmap for the next stage of platform transformation, ensuring continuity with current investments while enabling future scalability
* Translate business and data requirements into architectural decisions, reference designs, and technical standards
* Provide hands\-on architectural guidance to engineering teams on a day\-to\-day basis — not limited to design documents but actively engaged in delivery
* Evaluate and select technologies, tools, and vendors, with clear trade\-off analysis.
* Champion automation, self\-service, and infrastructure\-as\-code to reduce operational friction
* Identify architectural risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs across the platform and recommend mitigation strategies
* Define integration patterns, data flow designs, and governance standards across source ingestion, transformation, and consumption layers
* Establish and enforce architecture principles, design patterns, and platform standards across the team
* Collaborate with data governance, business, information security, enterprise architecture and technology stakeholders to align platform direction with enterprise requirements
* Support migration planning by defining target architectures, transition states, and validation strategies for workload migrations across platforms
* Drive decisions on platform tooling, infrastructure, and service selection in alignment with cloud and enterprise architecture standards

* Strong expertise in data modelling, data governance, data quality, lineage, CDC, SCD, audit, and control frameworks.Experience with Unity Catalog and Azure Purview for enterprise data governance.

### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.


Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.


You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
